snippet: Low-bit quantization reduces the inference cost of LLM agents but can compromise task success. We introduce SteerDistill, a quantization-aware distillation method in which a full-precision teacher guides the…
summary: SteerDistill is a quantization-aware distillation method where a full-precision teacher steers a low-bit LLM agent in a closed loop. It targets quantized agents that overlook task requirements or environment conditions and drift from successful full-precision rollouts.
